declared_before: the controlled DP runtime campaign that replaces the discarded first attempt; no rerun timing value had been observed
reason: The first controlled runtime attempt (2026-10-25 14:33-14:45 UTC) was discarded at the user's instruction: its own process snapshots showed CPU-bound processes from another project sharing solver CPU 2 in 9 of 10 measured rounds. Its readings were deleted, not retained.
sampler_placement: CPU 11, nice 19; reads only /proc/stat cpu2/cpu3 every 0.5 s

definitions.cpu2_settle_idle: CPU2 (idle+iowait)/total /proc/stat tick fraction between the first and last sampler readings inside each round's 60 s settling window; the solver is not running then.
definitions.foreign_cpu23_seconds: Sum of user+system CPU seconds accrued between consecutive runner process snapshots by processes outside the round launcher's process tree whose sampled CPU is 2 or 3 at both snapshots.
definitions.cpu3_idle_ratio: The runner's own recorded CPU3 /proc/stat idle fraction across settling and the runtime process.

applies_to: every round, including the saved warm-up
consequence: Any failed round rejects the whole campaign. A rejected campaign is not analyzed or reported; it is discarded and rerun under the unchanged runtime protocol after the host is quiet.
calibration: Thresholds were chosen before the rerun from the discarded attempt's process snapshots only (about 1.1 s foreign CPU2/3 time in its two clean rounds versus 16-65 s in contaminated rounds), never from its timing values, and from a 30 s quiet-host mpstat baseline (CPU2 94.5% idle with desktop background, CPU3 99.5%).
unchanged: results/p7/runtime-supplement.json protocol, solver caps, inputs, shuffle seed, settling, warm-up/measured rounds, statistics and acceptance.
